articles.title: Company Overview
articles.markdown:
# Company

**Northwind SaaS** sells collaborative project software for mid-market teams. Support covers seats, SSO, billing, and data export.

articles.title: Refund Policy
articles.markdown:
# Refunds

Monthly plans: unused seats can be removed at next renewal; no mid-cycle cash refunds. Annual plans: 14-day money-back from first invoice if under 5 active projects. Enterprise contracts follow the signed order form.

articles.title: SSO and Security
articles.markdown:
# SSO

SAML SSO is included on Business and Enterprise. Support can reset a workspace SSO config but cannot bypass MFA for an end user.
